Reviewer B claims: Severity: Medium
Reviewer B claims: Location: test/compatibility_lifecycle/cmd/feature_gates.go (lines 505-513)

Reviewer B claims: The change adds a new YAML field but doesn't update the dependency documentation or version requirements for the YAML library.
Reviewer B claims: The change follows existing patterns for version handling
Reviewer B claims: Proper omitempty tags were added for JSON/YAML serialization
Reviewer B claims: The test case covers both the code and YAML reference implementations
